cover_headline: Bajaj Finance Q2 Profit Rises 29% to Rs 6,367 Crore as NII Jumps 24%
facts: Consolidated net profit rose 28.7% year on year to Rs 6,366.57 crore in Q2 FY27, from Rs 4,947.76 crore a year earlier
Net interest income rose 24% to Rs 13,335 crore, and assets under management grew 26% to Rs 5,84,624 crore
Gross NPAs fell to 1.06% from 1.24% a year earlier, and the lender proposed raising up to Rs 17,500 crore in capital

end.headline: Bajaj Finance Q2 Profit Rises 29% to Rs 6,367 Crore as NII Jumps 24%
end.line: Profit, lending income and the loan book all grew by double digits in the July-September quarter, while asset quality improved.
